note: The bodies the two sides answer to. Every number is GAMEPLAY TUNING. A bloc's lean runs from -100 to 100; it is the bloc's general temper toward what its commander asks. How the members are grouped into three blocs is the game's. Contract: protocol/schemas/politics.yaml.

dispatch.note: A dispatch to London and its answer. The Cerberus took about five weeks to bring the three generals out in the spring of 1775; 38 days each way is the game's round figure.

ministry.note: Gage was recalled after Bunker Hill and Howe took the command in October 1775. The confidence figure and its floor are the game's.

bodies.name: Massachusetts Provincial Congress
bodies.note: The Provincial Congress governed Massachusetts outside Boston in the spring of 1775, sitting at Concord and then Watertown.

blocs.name: Committee men
blocs.moves: The Committee of Safety's friends. They want the army raised and used; a victory warms them, delay cools them.

blocs.name: Country towns
blocs.moves: Farmers' delegates. They count the cost in men and harvests; a lost battle near home frightens them.

blocs.name: Seaport merchants
blocs.moves: Trading towns with ships in the Navy's reach. They fear for their trade and warm slowly.

bodies.name: Continental Congress
bodies.note: The Second Continental Congress met at Philadelphia on 10 May 1775.

blocs.name: New England
blocs.moves: The war is at their door. They want an army and no talk of petitions.

blocs.name: Middle colonies
blocs.moves: New York and Pennsylvania still hope to be reconciled. Victories persuade them; a petition to the King pleases them.

blocs.name: Southern colonies
blocs.moves: They doubt a New England army led by New England men. A commander of their own choosing warms them.

bodies.name: The King's ministers
bodies.note: The commander at Boston answered to the Secretary of State for the Colonies, and depended on the Admiralty and the Treasury for ships and money.

blocs.name: Colonial Office
blocs.moves: Lord Dartmouth's office. It wants the rebellion ended quickly and loses patience with every check.

blocs.name: Admiralty
blocs.moves: The Navy's board. It will find ships for a commander who is winning.

blocs.name: Treasury
blocs.moves: Lord North's own board. It grudges every regiment and every convoy.
